name: cursor-auto-review
description: Triggers /review in Cursor chat automatically on pre-commit and/or pre-push, configurable per repo.

enumDescriptions: Fire-and-forget: prompt is sent to chat, commit/push proceeds immediately.
Commit/push waits for you to confirm Allow/Block in a Cursor dialog after reviewing the chat.
autoReview.mode.description: Whether the git hook blocks on your review confirmation.

autoReview.blockTimeoutSec.description: In block mode, how long the hook waits for your Allow/Block confirmation before falling back to blockOnTimeoutAllow.

autoReview.blockOnTimeoutAllow.description: In block mode, whether a timed-out confirmation allows (true) or blocks (false) the commit/push.

autoReview.chatShortcut.description: Key combined with Cmd to open Cursor chat (default matches Cmd+L).

autoReview.activationDelayMs.description: Delay after activating Cursor before sending keystrokes, to let the window focus settle.
